products.title: Pillars of Defense: Upper Body Joint Lock Escapes by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
Learn How To Masterfully Escape Any Upper Body Joint Lock With A Systematic Approach And Calm Confidence, As Gordon “The King” Ryan Shows You All The Lessons You Need To Know To Get Out From Armbars, Kimura, Omoplatas, And More!

  • Escape from any kind of serious upper body joint lock in grappling with lessons on getting out from any variation of the juji gatame, te gatame, kimura, americana, omoplata, and more!
  • Gordon “The King” Ryan is a multiple-time ADCC champion who is the most dominant and technical no-gi grappler on Earth, and this is your chance to learn his submission escaping!
  • Move from defense to offense with tips on how to find a counter offensive cycle within your escape - including entries to leg locks, back takes, and more!
  • Start to implement the enemy of offense so that you can supercharge your defense with conceptually powerful lessons on creating space and momentum
  • Gordon’s escaping skill is the basis of his game on the mat - now you can see all the ways he shuts down and gets out of upper body joint locks
  • See actual rolling footage from the gym as Gordon puts these techniques into action and then breaks down exactly what he was doing so you can see the techniques in motion


Learn How To Masterfully Escape Any Upper Body Joint Lock With A Systematic Approach And Calm Confidence, As Gordon “The King” Ryan Shows You All The Lessons You Need To Know To Get Out From Armbars, Kimura, Omoplatas, And More!

Check Out The Trailer!

What Will You Learn?

Join Gordon “The King” Ryan as the greatest no-gi grappler on Earth shows you how he goes about escaping from any and every upperbody submission joint lock, with lessons on how grapplers of all-levels can use these same techniques for maximum success in avoiding armbars, kimura, and more. Move from defense to offense with tips on how to find a counter offensive cycle within your escape - including entries to leg locks, back takes, and more!

Move out of powerful upper body submission holds, with tips on every variation, with ease as Gordon explains the central problems and keys to any troublesome upper body joint lock. Escape traditional juji gatame, ¾ juji, quarter juji, dorsal kimura, t-kimura, americanas, omoplata, and more! With each hold, you’ll get elite technique that can help you untie the knot you are stuck in.

Watch these systems in action as Gordon rolls live in the gym and then breaks down each roll - for you to see what he’s doing and hear why he’s doing it. He lets his opponents start in deep submission attempts before displaying the moves you just saw him teach, with breakdowns for you to follow along with.

Find The Way Out Of Near-Certain Submission Doom As Gordon “The King” Ryan - The Greatest No-Gi Grappler On Earth - Shows The Right Way To Escape Out Of An Encyclopedia Of Strangle Holds  

  • Gordon “The King” Ryan is a multiple-time ADCC champion who is the most dominant and technical no-gi grappler on Earth, and this is your chance to learn his pin escaping!
  • Use technique and conceptual lessons to escape from front triangles, wrong way triangles, rear triangles, reverse triangles, and side triangles
  • Gordon breaks down early escapes, late escapes, and ways out of strangles that really work against elite competitors
  • Solve submission dilemmas as Gordon explains the right way to prevent joint locks and strangles in the same position
  • See actual rolling footage from the gym as Gordon puts this system into action and then breaks down exactly what he was doing so you can see the techniques in motion                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               


Find The Way Out Of Near-Certain Submission Doom As Gordon “The King” Ryan - The Greatest No-Gi Grappler On Earth - Shows The Right Way To Escape Out Of An Encyclopedia Of Strangle Holds

Check Out The Trailer!

What Will You Learn?

Gordon “The King” Ryan, the greatest no-gi grappler on Earth, is back with BJJ Fanatics to show all of the most effective ways to escape from all of the most effective and common strangles in jiu-jitsu. Across 8-volumes, learn how you can master early and late defenses that will help you escape from triangles, guillotines, darces, and more strangles you will encounter on the mat.

In step-by-step fashion, you will get a guide on how you can get out of these holds and counter your way into better positions. Gordon shows you how to use techniques with maximum leverage, explaining not just what to do but why you are doing it, as he goes through each of the major strangles - broken down by upper body strangles (like a guillotine) and lower body strangles (like a triangle). 

Learn why you can only consider yourself a true master of a move once you understand the defense as Gordon explains how the escapes of each move influences the offense (and vice verse). 

Watch these systems in action as Gordon rolls live in the gym and then breaks down each roll - for you to see what he’s doing and hear why he’s doing it. With 8 volumes full of material for you to study, this offers you a full encyclopedia of all the major strangles that you’ll need to escape from, with full explanations from Gordon Ryan on how you should be building your way out from any of them.

products.title: The Pillars Of Defense Bundle by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
The complete The Pillars Of Defense series by Gordon Ryan in one bundle: 9 courses, 66 volumes.

  • All 9 courses of the The Pillars Of Defense series, each one complete with every volume
  • The same method applied position by position, so each course builds on the others
  • Watch on the BJJ Fanatics site or app, as many times as you need


What Will You Learn?

Gordon Ryan built the The Pillars Of Defense series one course at a time, each one focused on a single part of the game. This bundle puts all 9 together so you can study the series as one connected system.

Inside you will find: The Pillars of Defense: Back Escapes, The Pillars of Defense: Turtle & Front Headlock Escapes, The Pillars of Defense: Pin Escapes - Defensive to Offensive Cycles, Pillars of Defense: Upper Body Joint Lock Escapes, Pillars of Defense: Strangle Escapes, The Pillars Of Defense: Leg Lock Escapes and Counter Locks, The Pillars of Defense: Leg Locks to Guard Passing, Pillars of Defense: Leg Locks to Back Takes and Pillars of Defense: Guillotines.

products.title: The Pillars of Defense: Back Escapes by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
Stop The Strangles and Escape Back Control, Grappling’s Most Dominant Position, With A Complete System For Defensive Mastery From Gordon “The King” Ryan, The Best No-Gi Back Attacker Of All-Time!

  • Learn the hand fighting and positioning you need to stop strangles from coming in when your opponent has the back
  • Get back to safety from back control on the overhook and underhook side, including lessons on how to break the body triangle
  • Unlock the defensive secrets to the straight jacket system that Gordon uses to regularly tap elite black belts
  • Watch Gordon spar in live rounds from back, then break down his techniques so you can see the techniques in action
  • This escaping system is the same one that Gordon has used to dominate at the elite levels of no-gi grappling, with his coach John Danaher’s revolutionary concepts & dilemmas
  • Know more. Win more.

Gordon Teaches You Every Detail Of His System Across 8-volumes So That You Can Start Defending And Escaping With More Technique And Confidence

 

Check Out Sample!

What Will You Learn?

Start escaping from some of submission grappling’s worst positions with this 8-volume instructional series from Gordon “The King” Ryan as he shows you how he stays safe and gets away from back control. With techniques, strategies, and live rolling footage to break it all down, this is a total guide to getting away when someone takes your back and is ready to finish the fight.

Gordon Ryan is a 3-time ADCC Champion, the best no-gi grappler in the world today, and he is back with BJJ Fanatics to show you his game, broken down so grapplers of all levels can understand and benefit. As the best back attacker in submission grappling history, Gordon is uniquely suited to show you how to decode the defense and prevent the attacker from finishing you as you escape their control.

Learn the hand fighting tactics and fundamentals necessary for controlling the strangling arm and keeping yourself in the fight as you use spinning escapes, headlock escapes, and more to break away from their positional control. Gordon takes you into extreme detail on every step, giving you everything you’ll need to know to succeed.

Get out of some of grappling’s worst positions on the back, including how to break body triangles and how to free trapped arms. With Gordon’s help, you can begin attacking with the confidence that even if they take your back, you have the escaping ability to get back out and start attacking again.
